datasets.name: environmental_score_hourly
datasets.description: Hourly environmental suitability score by gateway. Grain: one row per UTC hour, gateway and score_version. Scores are computed from HOURLY AVERAGE temperature, humidity and soil moisture, not from every raw reading. environmental_score is NULL (never zero) when any of the three components is missing or outside its valid range; component scores are NULL when that component is unavailable.

fields.name: measurement_hour_utc
fields.description: Start of the UTC hour that was scored.

fields.name: gateway_id
fields.description: Gateway (greenhouse) that was scored.

fields.name: score_version
fields.description: Scoring rule version (currently conditions-v2). Scores from different versions are not comparable; filter to a single version if more than one is ever present.

fields.name: status
fields.description: 'complete' when all three components were available and the composite score exists; otherwise 'incomplete'.

fields.name: hour_of_day_utc
fields.description: UTC hour of day, 0-23.

fields.name: environmental_score_avg
fields.description: Average of the composite score over hours where it exists. NULL scores are skipped, not treated as zero.

fields.name: environmental_score_min
fields.description: Lowest composite hourly score.

fields.name: temperature_score_avg
fields.description: Average of the hourly temperature component score.

fields.name: humidity_score_avg
fields.description: Average of the hourly humidity component score.

fields.name: soil_score_avg
fields.description: Average of the hourly soil moisture component score.

fields.name: scored_hours

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN environmental_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.description: Hours with a non-null composite score.

fields.name: score_hours_total
fields.description: Hourly score rows, whether or not a composite exists.

datasets.name: actuator_cycles
datasets.description: Completed actuator ON->OFF cycles. Grain: one row per completed cycle (cycle_id is unique per actuator). Incomplete cycles are absent. Timestamps are UTC. Duration is the observed ON-to-OFF interval in seconds. Pump cycles paired by cycle_id are controller-verified; fan cycles are inferred from consecutive state changes.

fields.name: started_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the actuator was observed turning ON. All activity metrics are attributed to this time.

fields.name: ended_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the actuator was observed turning OFF. Not the default time axis; use only for questions about when cycles ended.

fields.name: actuator
fields.description: Actuator that ran, 'fan' or 'pump'.

fields.name: pairing_method
fields.description: How ON and OFF were matched: 'cycle_id' (shared controller cycle id, verified) or 'sequential_state' (next OFF after an ON, inferred).

fields.name: on_reason
fields.description: Controller reason on the ON state_changed event (for example shelly_status). Often NULL; do not rely on it to tell why a cycle started. Use automation_commands.reason for the commanded reason.

fields.name: off_reason
fields.description: Controller reason on the OFF event.

fields.name: start_hour_of_day_utc
fields.description: UTC hour of day (0-23) when the cycle started. Use to ask whether irrigation or cooling usually happens at the same time of day.

fields.name: cycles
fields.description: Completed cycles (distinct cycle per actuator).

fields.name: runtime_seconds
fields.description: Sum of cycle durations in seconds.

fields.name: cycle_duration_avg_seconds
fields.description: Average cycle duration in seconds.

fields.name: cycle_duration_max_seconds
fields.description: Longest cycle duration in seconds.

datasets.name: sensor_hourly
datasets.description: Hourly sensor statistics. Grain: one row per UTC hour, gateway, sensor, measurement type and unit, built from valid, deduplicated readings in int_sensor_readings. Soil moisture rows carry calibrated percent (unit 'percent'); other types carry their native unit. Minimum time grain is the hour: per-reading or sub-hour questions cannot be answered here.

fields.name: measurement_hour_utc
fields.description: Start of the UTC hour containing the readings.

fields.name: measurement_type
fields.description: Kind of measurement: air_temperature (celsius), relative_humidity (percent), soil_moisture (calibrated percent) or atmospheric_pressure (hpa). Always filter or group by this when a metric mixes types.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of avg/min/max values for the row.

fields.name: gateway_id
fields.description: Gateway (greenhouse) that produced the readings.

fields.name: sensor_id
fields.description: Sensor that produced the readings.

fields.name: hour_of_day_utc
fields.description: UTC hour of day, 0-23. Use to ask what time of day conditions peak. Greenhouse local time differs from UTC.

fields.name: day_of_week_utc
fields.description: ISO UTC weekday of the reading, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Use to compare weekdays. MetricFlow's extract_dow date part is not available in this version.

fields.name: reading_count
fields.description: Number of valid readings aggregated into the row.

fields.name: value_times_reading_count
fields.description: avg_value weighted by reading_count. Numerator of every weighted average; not meaningful on its own.

fields.name: min_value
fields.description: Smallest reading in the row (calibrated percent for soil).

fields.name: max_value
fields.description: Largest reading in the row (calibrated percent for soil).

fields.name: valid_range_reading_count
fields.description: Readings inside the scoring rule's valid range for their type (null for types without a rule).

fields.name: in_target_range_reading_count
fields.description: Readings inside the target interval of the scoring rules (inclusive of both limits).

fields.name: below_target_min_reading_count
fields.description: Readings strictly below the lower limit of the target interval.

datasets.name: automation_events
datasets.description: Automation lifecycle events. Grain: one row per deduplicated event (event_id is unique). Event types: command_issued, command_acknowledged, command_failed, state_changed. Timestamps are UTC. Use for event volumes and state transitions; use automation_commands for command outcomes.

fields.name: measured_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp at which the controller recorded the event.

fields.name: actuator
fields.description: Actuator the event concerns, 'fan' or 'pump'.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: command_issued, command_acknowledged, command_failed or state_changed.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Controller reason code. Seen so far: temperature_high, temperature_normal, soil_moisture_low (command_issued); shelly_status and initial_observation (state_changed); unexpected_pump_on, pump_command_runtime_exceeded and pump_runtime_exceeded (safety OFF commands); rpc_timeout_outcome_unknown or a device error text (command_failed). Often NULL on acknowledgments.

fields.name: desired_state
fields.description: Commanded relay state (true = ON, false = OFF) on command events; NULL on state_changed events.

fields.name: observed_state
fields.description: Relay state observed on state_changed events (true = ON, false = OFF); NULL on command events.

fields.name: is_initial_observation
fields.description: True for the first status read after the controller starts. Those state_changed rows record a starting state, not a transition.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Distinct automation events.

datasets.name: automation_commands
datasets.description: Actuator commands issued by the controller. Grain: one row per (actuator, command_id) taken from the command_issued event, with the first acknowledgment and first explicit failure joined on. Time axis is the issue time. A command with no acknowledgment is not necessarily lost: acknowledgments can arrive after the data was last built.

fields.name: issued_at_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the command_issued event.

fields.name: actuator
fields.description: Actuator commanded, 'fan' or 'pump'.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the controller issued the command: temperature_high or temperature_normal (fan), soil_moisture_low (pump), or a safety reason (unexpected_pump_on, pump_command_runtime_exceeded, pump_runtime_exceeded).

fields.name: desired_state
fields.description: Commanded relay state, true = ON, false = OFF.

fields.name: is_acknowledged
fields.description: True when at least one command_acknowledged event exists. Means the device accepted the RPC, not that the relay changed state.

fields.name: is_failed
fields.description: True when at least one command_failed event exists (explicit error or RPC timeout).

fields.name: is_timeout_outcome_unknown
fields.description: True when the failure was an RPC timeout; the actual outcome is unknown and the relay may have switched.

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.description: Reason on the first command_failed event, if any.

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Distinct commands issued.

fields.name: acknowledged_commands

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN is_acknowledged THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.description: Commands with at least one acknowledgment.

fields.name: failed_commands

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.description: Commands with at least one command_failed event.

fields.name: timeout_commands

dialects.expression: CASE WHEN is_timeout_outcome_unknown THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.description: Commands whose failure was an RPC timeout.

fields.name: acknowledgment_latency_avg_seconds
fields.description: Average seconds from issue to first acknowledgment.

metrics.name: avg_environmental_score
metrics.description: Average of valid hourly composite environmental scores (0-100) in the period; higher means conditions were closer to the configured target ranges. Each scored hour has equal weight, and hours with an incomplete set of components have no score and are excluded (see environmental_score_coverage_pct). Indicator of target alignment, not plant health. Equals fct_environmental_score_daily.avg_environmental_score at day grain.

metrics.name: min_environmental_score
metrics.description: Lowest valid hourly composite environmental score (0-100) in the period. Use to find the worst hour or day. Excludes unscored hours.

metrics.name: avg_temperature_score
metrics.description: Average hourly air temperature component score (0-100), where 100 means the hourly average temperature was inside the target interval. Use to see whether temperature is dragging the composite down. Component scores can exist for hours where the composite does not.

metrics.name: avg_humidity_score
metrics.description: Average hourly relative humidity component score (0-100), where 100 means the hourly average humidity was inside the target interval.

metrics.name: avg_moisture_score
metrics.description: Average hourly calibrated soil moisture component score (0-100), where 100 means the hourly average calibrated moisture was inside the target interval.

metrics.name: scored_hour_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN environmental_score_hourly.environmental_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Number of hours with a complete (non-null) composite environmental score. Use with environmental_score_coverage_pct to judge how much of the period the average score represents.

metrics.name: environmental_score_hour_count
metrics.description: Number of hourly score rows, including incomplete hours with no composite score. Denominator for environmental_score_coverage_pct.

metrics.name: environmental_score_coverage_pct

dialects.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN environmental_score_hourly.environmental_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(1), 0)

metrics.description: Percentage (0-100) of hourly score rows that have a complete composite score. Below 100 means some hours were missing a component or were out of valid range. Hours with no sensor data at all produce no row and are not counted here. NULL when there are no rows.

metrics.name: pct_temperature_readings_in_range

dialects.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.in_target_range_reading_count END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.valid_range_reading_count END), 0)

metrics.description: Percentage (0-100) of valid air temperature readings inside the target interval (20-26 C from the conditions rules, limits inclusive). Readings outside the rule's valid range (-10 to 60 C) are excluded from both the numerator and denominator. This is a share of READINGS, not of elapsed time, so uneven sampling or gaps can bias it. NULL when no readings.

metrics.name: pct_humidity_readings_in_range

dialects.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'relative_humidity' THEN sensor_hourly.in_target_range_reading_count END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'relative_humidity' THEN sensor_hourly.valid_range_reading_count END), 0)

metrics.description: Percentage (0-100) of valid relative humidity readings inside the target interval (85-97 % from the conditions rules, limits inclusive). A share of READINGS, not of elapsed time. NULL when no readings.

metrics.name: pct_moisture_readings_below_threshold

dialects.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.below_target_min_reading_count END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.valid_range_reading_count END), 0)

metrics.description: Percentage (0-100) of valid calibrated soil moisture readings strictly below 40 %, the lower target limit in the conditions rules and the same value the controller uses to trigger irrigation (PUMP_MOISTURE_THRESHOLD). The controller additionally requires several consecutive low readings, a cooldown and a daily cycle cap, so a high value does not mean irrigation was missed. Share of READINGS, not of elapsed time. NULL when no readings.

metrics.name: valid_range_reading_count
metrics.description: Readings inside the scoring rule's valid range. Building block for the pct_*_readings_* metrics; sums across measurement types unless filtered by sensor_hour__measurement_type.

metrics.name: in_target_range_reading_count
metrics.description: Readings inside the target interval (limits inclusive). Building block for pct_temperature_readings_in_range and pct_humidity_readings_in_range; filter by measurement_type.

metrics.name: below_target_min_reading_count
metrics.description: Readings strictly below the lower target limit. Building block for pct_moisture_readings_below_threshold; filter by measurement_type.

metrics.name: fan_cycle_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'fan' THEN actuator || ':' || cycle_id END)

metrics.description: Number of completed fan ON->OFF cycles that STARTED in the period (not when they ended). Zero for periods with no cycles. Fan cycles are inferred by pairing each observed ON with the next observed OFF, and a cycle still running is not counted. Group by metric_time__day for fan activity per day.

metrics.name: total_fan_runtime_seconds

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'fan' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Total measured runtime, in seconds, of completed fan cycles that STARTED in the period. Cycles are attributed entirely to their start time, so a cycle crossing midnight counts wholly toward the day it began. Zero when no cycles. Excludes any cycle still running. This is not a duty-cycle percentage.

metrics.name: total_fan_runtime_hours

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'fan' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END) / 3600.0

metrics.description: total_fan_runtime_seconds expressed in hours. Same attribution and limitations: completed cycles only, assigned to the day each started.

metrics.name: avg_fan_cycle_duration_seconds

dialects.expression: AVG(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'fan' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Mean duration, in seconds, of completed fan cycles started in the period. NULL when there were no cycles. Use to see whether fan cycles are getting longer; pair with avg_temperature_c by day to compare with how hot the day was. Whole-second resolution.

metrics.name: max_fan_cycle_duration_seconds

dialects.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'fan' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Duration in seconds of the longest completed fan cycle started in the period. NULL when there were no cycles.

metrics.name: pump_cycle_count

dialects.expression:
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'pump'
AND actuator_cycle__pairing_method = 'cycle_id' THEN actuator || ':' || cycle_id END)

metrics.description: Number of completed, controller-verified irrigation cycles that STARTED in the period. Counts only cycles whose ON and OFF share a cycle_id; pump activations without a cycle_id (not initiated as a controller irrigation cycle) and cycles still running are excluded. Zero when none. A cycle is one pump run, so this is "how many times the pump ran".

metrics.name: total_pump_runtime_seconds

dialects.expression:
SUM(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'pump'
AND actuator_cycle__pairing_method = 'cycle_id' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Total measured runtime, in seconds, of completed verified pump cycles that STARTED in the period (cycle_id pairs only). Whole-second resolution, so short runs carry large relative error. Zero when none.

metrics.name: avg_pump_cycle_duration_seconds

dialects.expression:
AVG(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'pump'
AND actuator_cycle__pairing_method = 'cycle_id' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Mean duration, in seconds, of completed verified pump cycles started in the period (cycle_id pairs only). NULL when there were no cycles.

metrics.name: max_pump_cycle_duration_seconds

dialects.expression:
MAX(CASE WHEN actuator_cycle__actuator = 'pump'
AND actuator_cycle__pairing_method = 'cycle_id' THEN actuator_cycles.duration_seconds END)

metrics.description: Duration in seconds of the longest completed verified pump cycle started in the period (cycle_id pairs only). NULL when none.

metrics.name: sensor_reading_count
metrics.description: Number of valid, deduplicated sensor readings. Building block: it sums across every measurement type, so group or filter by sensor_hour__measurement_type to get a meaningful figure. Prefer temperature_reading_count or soil_moisture_reading_count.

metrics.name: sensor_value_sum
metrics.description: Sum of individual reading values, reconstructed as avg_value x reading_count. Building block for weighted averages; it mixes units unless filtered to one measurement type. Do not report it directly.

metrics.name: avg_temperature_c

dialects.expression: (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN avg_value * reading_count END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.reading_count END))

metrics.description: Average air temperature in degrees Celsius over all valid readings in the period, weighted by reading count (not an average of hourly averages). Use for "what was the temperature", trends, and comparison across days or hours of day. Data is bucketed in UTC; readings outside the plausible range are not removed.

metrics.name: min_temperature_c

dialects.expression: MIN(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.min_value END)

metrics.description: Lowest single air temperature reading in the period, in degrees Celsius. Exact at any grain from hour upwards.

metrics.name: max_temperature_c

dialects.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.max_value END)

metrics.description: Highest single air temperature reading in the period, in degrees Celsius. Use to find hottest days or the hottest hour of day.

metrics.name: temperature_range_c

dialects.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.max_value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.min_value END)

metrics.description: Maximum minus minimum air temperature reading in the period, in degrees Celsius. A simple measure of temperature variability or extremes; it is driven by single readings, so one noisy reading widens it. Group by a day or longer grain; at the hour grain it only describes that hour.

metrics.name: temperature_reading_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'air_temperature' THEN sensor_hourly.reading_count END)

metrics.description: Number of valid air temperature readings. Use to judge how much data supports a temperature average, or to find gaps in sensor coverage.

metrics.name: avg_humidity_pct

dialects.expression: (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'relative_humidity' THEN avg_value * reading_count END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'relative_humidity' THEN sensor_hourly.reading_count END))

metrics.description: Average relative humidity in percent (0-100) over all valid readings in the period, weighted by reading count. Use for humidity levels and for whether humidity is rising or falling across days.

metrics.name: avg_soil_moisture_pct

dialects.expression: (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN avg_value * reading_count END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.reading_count END))

metrics.description: Average calibrated soil moisture in percent (0-100) over all valid readings in the period, weighted by reading count. Calibrated moisture is the share of the 10 most recent raw capacitive readings at or above 990, so it is a proxy for how consistently the sensor reads wet, not volumetric water content. Use for moisture trends and variation by hour of day.

metrics.name: min_soil_moisture_pct

dialects.expression: MIN(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.min_value END)

metrics.description: Lowest calibrated soil moisture reading in the period, in percent. Calibrated values move in steps because they are a rolling share of 10 raw readings.

metrics.name: max_soil_moisture_pct

dialects.expression: MAX(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.max_value END)

metrics.description: Highest calibrated soil moisture reading in the period, in percent.

metrics.name: soil_moisture_reading_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN sensor_hour__measurement_type = 'soil_moisture' THEN sensor_hourly.reading_count END)

metrics.description: Number of valid soil moisture readings (each carries a calibrated value). The first 9 readings per sensor use a partial 10-reading window.

metrics.name: automation_event_count
metrics.description: Number of distinct automation events recorded in the period, across all event types. Group by automation_event__event_type, actuator or reason to break it down. Includes initial_observation status reads; use state_change_count for actual transitions. Zero when none.

metrics.name: state_change_count

dialects.expression:
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN automation_event__event_type = 'state_changed'
AND automation_event__is_initial_observation = FALSE THEN automation_events.event_id END)

metrics.description: Number of observed actuator state transitions (state_changed events), excluding initial_observation reads, in the period. Each ON or OFF is one change, so a full cycle is two. Group by automation_event__observed_state for ON versus OFF. Counts what the relay reported, regardless of whether the controller commanded it. Zero when none.

metrics.name: command_issued_count
metrics.description: Number of distinct actuator commands issued in the period (one per command_id, including safety OFF commands). Denominator for command_acknowledgment_rate_pct. Zero when none.

metrics.name: command_acknowledged_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_acknowledged THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Number of commands ISSUED in the period that were explicitly acknowledged at least once. Counts each command once however many acknowledgments or retries exist. Acknowledged means the device accepted the RPC, not that the relay changed state. Zero when none.

metrics.name: command_failure_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Number of commands ISSUED in the period with at least one command_failed event: an explicit device error or an RPC timeout. Each command is counted once. Includes timeouts whose outcome is unknown (see command_timeout_count); a failed command may still have switched the relay. Zero when none.

metrics.name: command_timeout_count

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_timeout_outcome_unknown THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.description: Number of commands ISSUED in the period whose command_failed event was an RPC timeout (reason rpc_timeout_outcome_unknown). A subset of command_failure_count. The outcome is unknown, not a proven failure. Zero when none.

metrics.name: unexpected_pump_on_command_count

dialects.expression:
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN command__actuator = 'pump'
AND command__reason = 'unexpected_pump_on' THEN automation_commands.command_id END)

metrics.description: Number of pump OFF commands issued in the period because the controller saw the pump ON with no active irrigation cycle (reason unexpected_pump_on). It counts the controller's RESPONSES, one per command, and retries every few seconds are separate commands, so it overstates the number of distinct unexpected activations. Other pump safety shutoffs (runtime exceeded) are excluded. Zero when none.

metrics.name: command_acknowledgment_rate_pct

dialects.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_acknowledged THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT automation_commands.command_id), 0)

metrics.description: Percentage (0-100) of distinct commands issued in the period that were acknowledged at least once. Cohort measure by issue time, so a command acknowledged after the period ends still counts. Acknowledgment shows the device accepted the RPC; it is not proof the relay changed state and must not be read as an execution success rate. NULL when no commands were issued. Very recent commands may not yet have an acknowledgment in the warehouse.

metrics.name: avg_command_acknowledgment_latency_seconds
metrics.description: Average seconds between a command being issued and its first acknowledgment, for commands issued in the period that were acknowledged. NULL when none were acknowledged. Measures the RPC round trip as seen by the controller, not relay switching time.
